verdict.gold_reason: Article 6(10) of Regulation 2019/943 lets the regulatory authority, at the TSO's request, extend the contractual period of the remaining part of balancing capacity to a maximum of twelve months. Article 6(11) says that from 1 January 2026 contract periods shall not be longer than six months. Both points are in the gold article.
verdict.ambiguity_reason: The question says 'reserve capacity contracts' where the article says 'balancing capacity'. The 'remaining part' wording is consistent with Art. 6(9)-(10). The twelve-month extension is conditional on the TSO's request and on limits in time and effect, but the answer states the request condition.
